description.zh: 吉萨金字塔群由三座大金字塔和斯芬克斯狮身人面像组成，建于约公元前2560年。大金字塔（胡夫金字塔）高146.5米，是古代世界七大奇迹中唯一保存至今的建筑，也是世界上最古老的世界遗产之一。
description.en: The Giza Pyramid complex, built around 2560 BC, comprises three great pyramids and the Great Sphinx. The Great Pyramid of Khufu (146.5 m) is the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World and one of humanity's oldest UNESCO sites.

zh: 世界遗产
古代奇迹
古埃及
古代世界七大奇迹中唯一现存的建筑
胡夫大金字塔高146米，建于公元前2560年
狮身人面像（斯芬克斯）守护在金字塔旁
en: The only surviving structure of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
Great Pyramid of Khufu — 146 m; built ~2560 BC

admission.zh: 景区门票约160埃及镑，内部参观另收费
admission.en: Site entry ~EGP$160; interior entry charged separately

tips.zh: 骑骆驼或马车拍摄角度极佳，但价格需提前谈好。清晨是拍摄金字塔的最佳时机，光线柔和人也少。
tips.en: Camel rides offer excellent photo angles — agree on the price before mounting. Early morning gives the softest light and smallest crowds; heat is brutal by midday.

name.zh: 卢克索神庙群（古代底比斯）

description.zh: 卢克索古称「底比斯」，是古埃及最重要的宗教中心。卢克索神庙和卡纳克神庙组成世界上最大的神庙建筑群，「帝王谷」中安息着图坦卡蒙等众多法老。1979年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: Ancient Luxor was Thebes, Egypt's greatest religious capital. Luxor and Karnak temples form the world's largest temple complex; the Valley of the Kings holds Tutankhamun and dozens of other pharaohs. Inscribed as UNESCO WHC in 1979.

zh: 世界遗产
古埃及神庙
帝王谷
卡纳克神庙：全球最大的宗教建筑群之一
帝王谷：藏有图坦卡蒙等法老的60余座墓穴
卢克索神庙夜间灯光效果震撼人心
en: Karnak Temple — one of the world's largest religious complexes
Valley of the Kings — over 60 royal tombs including Tutankhamun's
Luxor Temple lit up at night is magnificent

admission.zh: 帝王谷约240埃及镑（含3座墓穴），卡纳克约150埃及镑
admission.en: Valley of the Kings ~EGP$240 (3 tombs); Karnak ~EGP$150

duration.zh: 一天（西岸）加一天（东岸神庙）

tips.zh: 租自行车游览西岸最为灵活惬意；帝王谷内图坦卡蒙墓需另付费，王后谷门票另计。
tips.en: Renting a bicycle to explore the west bank is the most enjoyable option. Tutankhamun's tomb requires an extra ticket inside the Valley of the Kings.

description.zh: 乘坐传统费卢卡帆船或豪华游轮沿尼罗河航行，是欣赏埃及沿岸古迹的最佳方式。从卢克索到阿斯旺的经典航线沿途经过众多古庙和农村景色，是每位埃及旅者不可错过的体验。
description.en: Sailing the Nile on a traditional felucca or luxury cruise ship is the finest way to take in Egypt's riverside antiquities. The classic Luxor-to-Aswan route passes ancient temples and timeless rural landscapes.

zh: 游轮
尼罗河
古迹沿岸
世界最长河流（约6,650公里）的千年文明走廊
三天或四天经典路线：卢克索—孔翁博—阿斯旺
沿岸神庙、农田和当地市集的真实埃及风情
en: Corridor of ancient civilisation along the world's longest river (~6,650 km)
Classic 3–4 night cruise: Luxor – Kom Ombo – Aswan
Riverside temples, farmland and local market towns

tips.zh: 10月至4月气候宜人是最佳时节；6—9月高温超过40度，夏季价格较低。选择持有执照导游的游轮。
tips.en: October–April is the most pleasant season; summer can exceed 40°C (though prices drop). Choose a licensed cruise operator with qualified guides.

name.zh: 努比亚遗址（阿布辛贝至菲莱）
name.en: Nubian Monuments — Abu Simbel to Philae

description.zh: 阿布辛贝神庙是拉美西斯二世于公元前13世纪建造的岩凿神庙，四座高达20米的拉美西斯巨像守护着神庙入口。1968年整体迁移以避水库淹没，是人类文化遗产保护史上的奇迹。该遗址群包括菲莱岛神庙等众多努比亚古迹，1979年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: Abu Simbel was carved from rock by Ramesses II in the 13th century BC, guarded by four 20 m colossi. Its 1968 relocation to avoid Lake Nasser is one of the greatest feats in heritage conservation history. The site group includes Philae Island temples and numerous Nubian monuments, inscribed as UNESCO WHC in 1979.

zh: 世界遗产
古埃及神庙
拉美西斯二世
拉美西斯二世下令建造的4尊20米高巨型坐像
1968年为修建阿斯旺水坝，整座神庙被切割搬迁至今址
2月22日和10月22日，阳光精准穿入神庙深处照亮内殿
en: Four 20-m colossi of Ramesses II carved from solid rock
Entire temple relocated in 1968 to save it from the Aswan Dam reservoir
On 22 Feb and 22 Oct, sunlight penetrates to illuminate the inner sanctuary

tips.zh: 从阿斯旺驱车约4小时（或乘早班飞机）可达；太阳节（2月22日）门票需提前数月预订。
tips.en: About 4 hours' drive from Aswan (or a short flight). Sun Festival tickets (22 Feb) must be reserved months ahead — it's a once-in-a-lifetime spectacle.

description.zh: 开罗埃及博物馆（现与大埃及博物馆GEM共存）收藏了超过16万件古埃及文物，其中包括图坦卡蒙的黄金面具和木乃伊展厅。是全球最重要的古埃及文物收藏地。
description.en: Cairo's Egyptian Museum houses over 160,000 ancient artefacts including Tutankhamun's golden mask and the Royal Mummies Hall. It is the world's pre-eminent collection of ancient Egyptian antiquities.

zh: 博物馆
黄金面具
木乃伊
埃及考古博物馆：全球最重要的古埃及文物收藏
图坦卡蒙的黄金面具和约5,000件随葬品原件
超过120,000件文物，需数日才能全部参观
en: Egyptian Museum: the world's most important collection of ancient Egyptian artefacts
Tutankhamun's gold death mask and ~5,000 original tomb objects
Over 120,000 pieces — days needed to see it all

admission.zh: 约200埃及镑（图坦卡蒙馆另收约100埃及镑）

tips.zh: 强烈建议雇佣持证讲解员，否则大量文物缺乏背景知识很难理解其意义。开罗解放广场旁，交通便捷。
tips.en: A licensed guide makes an enormous difference — without context, many artefacts lose their significance. Located on Tahrir Square, very central.

name.zh: 孟菲斯及其墓地（吉萨至达哈舒尔金字塔区）
name.en: Memphis and its Necropolis — Pyramid Fields from Giza to Dahshur

description.zh: 以古都孟菲斯为中心的金字塔场域，涵盖从吉萨到达哈舒尔的完整金字塔群，包括吉萨三大金字塔、阶梯金字塔、弯曲金字塔和红色金字塔。这片区域是古王国时期（约公元前2686—2181年）皇家陵寝的核心，1979年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: The pyramid fields centred on ancient Memphis span from Giza to Dahshur, encompassing the Giza trio, the Step Pyramid at Saqqara, and the Bent and Red Pyramids at Dahshur. This zone is the royal necropolis of the Old Kingdom (c. 2686–2181 BC), inscribed as UNESCO WHC in 1979.

zh: 世界遗产
古埃及
金字塔群

location.zh: 开罗以南，吉萨至达哈舒尔，埃及
location.en: South of Cairo, Giza to Dahshur, Egypt

zh: 萨卡拉的左塞尔阶梯金字塔——人类历史上最古老的纪念性石构建筑
达哈舒尔的弯曲金字塔和红色金字塔展示了金字塔形制的演变过程
覆盖数十座金字塔的宏大皇家陵寝区，跨越古王国历代法老
en: Djoser's Step Pyramid at Saqqara — humanity's oldest monumental stone structure
Dahshur's Bent and Red Pyramids showing the evolution of pyramid design
Dozens of pyramids across successive Old Kingdom pharaohs

admission.zh: 萨卡拉景区约180埃及镑，达哈舒尔约60埃及镑

duration.zh: 一天（萨卡拉+达哈舒尔联游）

tips.zh: 可与吉萨金字塔安排在不同天游览；萨卡拉的梅雷鲁卡墓彩色浮雕保存完好，值得单独参观。
tips.en: Best spread over separate days from the Giza complex. The painted reliefs inside Mereruka's mastaba at Saqqara are among Egypt's finest and worth dedicated time.

description.zh: 历史开罗是伊斯兰世界最古老的城市之一，保存着600余座清真寺、宫殿和商队驿站，以阿兹哈尔清真寺、伊本·图伦清真寺和汗·哈利利大市集最为著名。这片城区自公元969年法蒂玛王朝建城以来几乎未曾中断，1979年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: Historic Cairo is one of Islam's oldest cities, preserving 600+ mosques, palaces and caravanserais, most famously Al-Azhar Mosque, Ibn Tulun Mosque and the Khan el-Khalili bazaar. The urban fabric has been virtually continuous since the Fatimid founding in 969 AD; inscribed as UNESCO WHC in 1979.

zh: 世界遗产
伊斯兰建筑
历史城区
爱资哈尔清真寺（公元970年）——世界上历史最悠久的大学之一
汗·哈利利大市集：迷宫般的传统集市，出售香料、香水和工艺品
萨拉丁城堡俯瞰开罗全城，城内有穆罕默德·阿里清真寺
en: Al-Azhar Mosque (970 AD) — one of the world's oldest universities
Khan el-Khalili bazaar — labyrinthine market of spices, perfumes and crafts
Saladin Citadel overlooks the city and contains the Muhammad Ali Mosque

admission.zh: 大部分清真寺免费，城堡约180埃及镑

tips.zh: 进入清真寺需脱鞋，女性需佩戴头巾；午间祈祷时间（约12:30—13:30）清真寺不对非穆斯林开放，请留意时间安排。
tips.en: Remove shoes before entering mosques; women should cover their hair. Mosques close to non-Muslims during Friday noon prayers (~12:30–13:30).

name.zh: 阿布梅纳早期基督教遗址

description.zh: 阿布梅纳是埃及亚历山大附近的早期基督教圣城遗址，建于公元4世纪，是早期基督教最重要的朝圣地之一。以纪念圣梅纳斯殉道士的圣殿和地下教堂闻名，1979年列入世界遗产名录，目前已列入濒危世界遗产名单。
description.en: Abu Mena is the ruined site of an early Christian holy city near Alexandria, built in the 4th century around the tomb of St Menas. Once one of early Christianity's greatest pilgrimage centres, it was inscribed as UNESCO WHC in 1979 and is currently on the List of World Heritage in Danger.

zh: 世界遗产
早期基督教
濒危遗产

location.zh: 亚历山大以南约45公里，埃及北部
location.en: ~45 km south of Alexandria, northern Egypt

zh: 公元4世纪建造的早期基督教圣城遗址
圣梅纳斯殉道士纪念建筑群的残存遗迹
地下水位上升导致部分遗址下沉，是典型的濒危文化遗址
en: Ruins of one of early Christianity's most important pilgrimage cities
Remains of the basilica complex built over St Menas' tomb
Rising groundwater is causing subsidence — a striking example of heritage at risk

tips.zh: 适合对早期基督教历史感兴趣的访客；需要自驾前往，公共交通不便利。建议与亚历山大市内景点联游。
tips.en: Best suited to visitors with an interest in early Christian history. Self-drive required; public transport is limited. Combine with Alexandria's sights on the same day.

description.zh: 圣凯瑟琳地区位于西奈半岛南部，包含西奈山（摩西山）和圣凯瑟琳修道院。西奈山是《圣经》记载摩西接受十诫之地，圣凯瑟琳修道院建于公元565年，是世界上最古老的持续运作的基督教修道院，2002年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: The Saint Catherine area in southern Sinai contains Mount Sinai — where Moses received the Ten Commandments — and St Catherine's Monastery (565 AD), the world's oldest continuously operating Christian monastery. Inscribed as UNESCO WHC in 2002.

zh: 世界遗产
宗教圣地
修道院

location.zh: 西奈半岛南部，南西奈省，埃及
location.en: South Sinai Peninsula, South Sinai Governorate, Egypt

zh: 西奈山（2,285米）——《圣经》中摩西领受十诫之处
圣凯瑟琳修道院——公元565年建造，世界最古老的持续运作修道院
修道院图书馆藏有早期基督教手稿，与梵蒂冈齐名
en: Mount Sinai (2,285 m) — biblical site where Moses received the Ten Commandments
St Catherine's Monastery (565 AD) — the world's oldest continuously operating monastery
Library holds manuscripts rivalling the Vatican's collection in age and importance

admission.zh: 修道院免费（周五关闭），西奈山徒步无需门票
admission.en: Monastery free (closed Fridays); hiking Mount Sinai requires no fee but guide is recommended

tips.zh: 登西奈山通常在凌晨2—3点出发赶看日出，需准备御寒衣物；从达哈卜或沙姆沙伊赫驾车约1.5小时。
tips.en: Most hikers depart for the summit at 2–3 a.m. to catch sunrise — bring warm layers even in summer. About 1.5 hours' drive from Dahab or Sharm el-Sheikh.

description.zh: 鲸谷位于埃及西部沙漠，保存着4000万年前古鲸类（龙王鲸等）的化石遗迹，是研究鲸鱼从陆地动物演化为海洋哺乳动物过程的最重要遗址。壮观的沙漠地貌与古生物化石并存，2005年列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: Wadi Al-Hitan in Egypt's Western Desert preserves the fossils of ancient whales (Archaeoceti) from 40 million years ago, making it the world's most important site for understanding the evolution of whales from land mammals. Inscribed as UNESCO WHC in 2005.

zh: 世界遗产
古生物化石
自然遗产

location.zh: 法尤姆省西部沙漠，埃及西部

zh: 4000万年前古鲸类化石——展示鲸鱼从四足陆生动物进化的证据
数百具完整的古鲸骨架散布于沙漠之中
联合国教科文组织世界自然遗产，非洲唯一的古鲸化石产地
en: 40-million-year-old archaeocete fossils showing the transition from land-dwelling ancestors
Hundreds of complete ancient whale skeletons exposed in the desert landscape
UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site; Africa's only significant archaeocete fossil locality

tips.zh: 从开罗驾车约3小时，沙漠路面需四驱车辆；景区内有露天博物馆，可直接观察保存在原地的化石。
tips.en: About 3 hours from Cairo; a 4WD vehicle is required for the desert tracks. The open-air museum lets you walk among fossils in situ — a unique experience.

name.zh: 达哈舒尔金字塔（候选遗产）

description.zh: 达哈舒尔金字塔群包含弯曲金字塔和红色金字塔，是古埃及金字塔建筑发展史上的关键节点，展示了从阶梯式到标准三角形金字塔的演变过程。弯曲金字塔因建设途中改变角度而呈现独特的双坡形态，已列入埃及世界遗产候选名单。
description.en: Dahshur's Bent and Red Pyramids are pivotal monuments in the history of pyramid architecture, bridging the Step Pyramid and the true pyramid. The Bent Pyramid's unique double slope records a mid-construction design change. On Egypt's UNESCO tentative list.

zh: 候选遗产
金字塔
古埃及

location.zh: 达哈舒尔，开罗以南约40公里，吉萨省
location.en: Dahshur, ~40 km south of Cairo, Giza Governorate

zh: 弯曲金字塔——独特的双坡形状记录了建造中途改变角度的历史
红色金字塔——世界上最古老的真正三角形金字塔，内部可入
游客稀少，可近距离欣赏古王国金字塔而无大量人群干扰
en: Bent Pyramid — unique double slope recording a mid-construction change of plan
Red Pyramid — the world's oldest true pyramid with an accessible interior
Far fewer tourists than Giza; exceptional close-up views of Old Kingdom monuments

tips.zh: 常与萨卡拉组成一日联游；红色金字塔内部通道低矮，需弯腰前行，建议穿舒适服装。
tips.en: Typically combined with Saqqara as a full-day excursion. The Red Pyramid's interior passages are very low — wear comfortable clothes and be prepared to crouch.

name.zh: 西奈半岛南部（候选遗产）

description.zh: 西奈半岛南部以红海沿岸的珊瑚礁、沙姆沙伊赫和达哈卜的潜水胜地以及内陆的彩色峡谷（Colored Canyon）著称。该地区拥有独特的自然和文化双重价值，已列入埃及的世界遗产候选名单。
description.en: South Sinai is celebrated for its Red Sea coral reefs, the diving meccas of Sharm el-Sheikh and Dahab, and the inland Colored Canyon. The area combines outstanding natural and cultural values and appears on Egypt's UNESCO tentative list.

zh: 候选遗产
红海
潜水

location.zh: 西奈半岛南端，南西奈省，埃及
location.en: Southern tip of Sinai Peninsula, South Sinai Governorate, Egypt

zh: 达哈卜蓝洞——世界顶级自由潜水和水肺潜水胜地
沙姆沙伊赫珊瑚礁——红海生物多样性最丰富的海域之一
彩色峡谷：砂岩层多彩纹路构成的天然艺术画廊
en: Dahab Blue Hole — one of the world's premier freediving and scuba sites
Sharm el-Sheikh reefs — among the Red Sea's most biodiverse marine areas
Colored Canyon — a natural gallery of multicoloured sandstone layers

admission.zh: 峡谷约50埃及镑，潜水另计
admission.en: Canyon ~EGP$50; diving costs vary by operator

tips.zh: 10月至5月水温宜人、能见度最佳；6—9月气温极高。达哈卜比沙姆沙伊赫更为宁静，适合长时间停留。
tips.en: October–May offers the best water temperature and visibility. June–September is extremely hot. Dahab is calmer and cheaper than Sharm — ideal for a longer stay.
